response_raw:
Factory_Pipeline
agents:
	robots: Robot1, Robot2
locations: warehouse, surface_texturization_start, surface_texturization_end, laser_start, laser_end, loading_area
resources: raw_materials, texturized_materials, lasered_materials
Robot1 default stop:
	1: moveTo warehouse
	2: pick raw_materials
	3: moveTo surface_texturization_start
	4: deposit raw_materials
	5-12:
Robot2 default stop:
	1-4:
	5: moveTo surface_texturization_end
	6: pick texturized_materials
	7: moveTo laser_start
	8: deposit texturized_materials
	9: moveTo laser_end
	10: pick lasered_materials
	11: moveTo loading_area
	12: deposit lasered_materials
success: position(Robot2, loading_area) && !possess(Robot2, lasered_materials)
failure: time(100)
